snippet.title: Verse VR | Upload VR Showcase BTS Feature | Meta Quest | Steam
snippet.description:
As just seen at the Summer 2025 Upload VR Showcase, an exclusive mini-featurette announcing the release of VERSE VR – OUT NOW!

Step into a richly immersive world shaped by creativity. VERSE VR invites you to explore eight stunning environments—each filled with art, poetry, and music from around the world, including a serene Chinese garden, ancient ruins, and a lively West African village.

This featurette includes an introduction with Judith Cheung, Creative Director of the game, and Theirno Soumaré of the Batuki Music Society, cultural consultant for the West African levels of Verse VR, as they share the vision and inspiration behind the project.


Play VERSE VR today:

Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/verse-vr-deluxe/8512122905577311/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958710/Verse_VR/?beta=0

Learn more at https://versevr.app/

 #vr #meditation #culture #music #poetry #oculus #steamvr #vrgaming #metaquest2 #metaquest3
